name: Iron Palm
description: Lay metal qi over the open hand until it is hard as iron, then drive the heel of the palm into one foe's chest or raised guard.

name: Steel Knuckle
description: Coat the closed fist in a skin of hardened qi and punch through a single foe's forearm guard.

name: Iron Forearm
description: Harden the forearm with metal qi and take a heavy blow on it, so the user's own bone does not break.

name: Metal Grip
description: Close a hand hardened with metal qi on a foe's wrist and hold it, so the foe cannot draw back the arm.

name: Iron Pace
description: Set the lead foot down weighted with metal qi so the user advances a pace without being pushed off the line.

name: Ringing Fist
description: Keep metal qi humming through the fist across a string of punches, so each blow on one foe lands with the same hard ring.

name: Steel Skin
description: Draw metal qi into the skin of the torso so that it turns a glancing cut or a blunt hit aimed at the user.

name: Hard Shoulder
description: Harden the shoulder and upper arm with metal qi to take a swung weapon on the user's own body.

name: Bronze Shell
description: Hold a thin shell of metal qi over the whole body for a short span, shielding the user from blows that fall one after another.

name: Edge Dulling
description: Meet a foe's blade with a skin-hard forearm turned slightly aside, so the edge skids and loses its bite on the user.

name: Iron Spine
description: Stiffen the back with metal qi so it bears a long press or a crushing grip without bending.

name: Seam Mending
description: Draw the lips of a shallow cut together with a thread of metal qi so the user's own wound closes and stops bleeding.

name: Steel Ram
description: Turn a hardened shoulder into a ram and drive it into one foe's torso at the end of a short run.

name: Needle Flick
description: Flick a slender needle of hardened metal qi from the fingertips at a single foe a few paces off.

name: Twin Pins
description: Loose two needles of qi side by side so that if one is struck aside the other still finds the same foe.

name: Threadpoint
description: Thrust a needle of qi, held in the fingers, through a gap in a foe's leather or cloth guard to prick the flesh below.

name: Needle Listening
description: Cast a needle of qi at a surface and read from its ring what lies behind it, solid or hollow, for the user's own knowledge.

name: Pin Screen
description: Spread a loose fan of needles before the body to knock small thrown objects and darts off their line.

name: Pin Rain
description: Keep casting needle after needle at one foe in a steady stream while the user holds the metal qi in the hand.

name: Copper Thread
description: Spin a thin thread of metal qi from the fingers and wind it once round a foe's ankle or wrist to slow the limb.

name: Wire Loop
description: Throw a loop of wire qi over a foe's arm or weapon hand and cinch it shut to pin the limb for a breath.

name: Wire Whip
description: Snap a length of wire qi like a whip across one foe's face or hands.

name: Copper Lash
description: Keep the wire whirling in a circle about the user and lash every foe who comes in range, one at a time.

name: Wire Tug
description: Loop wire qi round a foe's weapon arm and tug at the instant the foe swings, throwing the stroke off its mark.

name: Wire Wrap
description: Wind wire qi quickly round the forearm in several turns so it stands up to a blade or a club.

name: Copper Spool
description: Pay out a thread of qi along a surface and feel through it what the thread touches, for the user's own knowledge.

name: Lodestone Step
description: Let the pull of metal qi in a nearby iron post, rail or plate tug the user one long stride toward it.

name: Iron Draw
description: Pull at the iron in a foe's weapon so the weapon drags and the foe's guard opens.

name: Cling Hold
description: Bind the user's boots and hands by metal pull to a plate or rail so a shove or a drag cannot move the user.

name: Metal Tether
description: Draw a foe's metal gear toward a fixed iron object and hold it there, so the foe is dragged back by his own belt, buckle or buckler.

name: Metal Calling
description: Open the metal affinity outward to feel where iron, bronze or steel lies near the user, and how much of it.

name: Draw Toss
description: Pull a loose piece of iron to the hand and fling it on at a single foe in the same motion.

name: Edge Whetting
description: Run metal qi along a blade held by the user or an ally to sharpen the edge for the next few strokes.

name: Keen Edge
description: Keep a thin film of metal qi on an ally's blade so its edge stays keen through a whole exchange.

name: Weight Lending
description: Press metal qi into a blade or hammer so it falls heavier in the hand of the user or an ally.

name: Honed Cut
description: Draw the honed blade across one foe's guard arm in a clean stroke with metal qi in the edge.

name: Edge Weighing
description: Run metal qi along a blade and read at once its balance, its flaws and how true the edge is.

name: Temper Touch
description: Touch the flat of an ally's blade and harden it with metal qi so it resists chipping and bending for a while.

name: Keen Slash
description: Sweep the honed blade in a run of linked slashes at one foe while metal qi stays in the edge.

name: Coin Flick
description: Flick a coin with metal qi from the thumb so that it flies flat and true at one foe's face or hand.

name: Copper Spin
description: Keep a coin spinning in the air before the user by metal qi and send it on at a foe when it has cut up speed.

name: Coin Pair
description: Throw two coins one after the other along crossed lines so they meet at the same foe.

name: Coin Edge
description: Hold a coin edge outward between two fingers, sharpened by metal qi, and draw it across a foe's wrist.

name: Coin Catch
description: Snap a coin in front of an arrow or dart and let its metal pull turn the small missile aside.

name: Coin Recall
description: Throw a coin past one foe and call it back by metal pull, so it strikes him a second time on the return.

name: Nail Drive
description: Hold a nail of metal qi in the fist and drive it point first through a gap in a foe's armor.

name: Rivet Shot
description: Snap a short rivet of metal qi from the thumb at one foe's eyes or throat.

name: Pinning Nail
description: Drive a nail of qi through a foe's sleeve or cloak into the post behind him and pin him in place for a breath.

name: Spike Heel
description: Grow a spike of qi from the heel to plant in the ground, so the user stops short or turns sharply.

name: Nail Brace
description: Set nails of qi through the cuffs of the forearm so a blade runs into them and does not reach the skin.

name: Nail Hammer
description: Strike the head of a held nail of qi with the other fist so its point goes through a foe's guard like a driven stake.

name: Iron Tack
description: Flick a tack of metal qi at a foe's lead foot so the foot stings and the stance breaks.

name: Bell Knuckle
description: Hit one foe with a hardened fist that rings as it lands, so the shock runs through his body.

name: Ringing Palm
description: Strike again and again with the open palm while metal qi sustains a bell tone along the arm.

name: Tone Ward
description: Set the body ringing at the instant of a blow so the force of it scatters through the tone.

name: Chime Listening
description: Strike a small metal object with a flick of qi and listen to the answering tone of other metal nearby.

name: Bell Shiver
description: Ring a note of metal qi against a foe's weapon so his grip shakes and his next cut goes wide.

name: Hum Step
description: Let a low hum in the body lighten the stride, so the user slips one pace to either side.

name: Plate Bloom
description: Draw metal qi from the air into a flat plate that grows over the user's chest and turns an incoming stroke.

name: Grown Buckler
description: Grow a small round shield on the forearm out of ambient metal qi and keep it whole through a bout.

name: Scale Layer
description: Raise overlapping scales of grown metal along the arms and shoulders so cuts slide off them.

name: Plate Edge
description: Sharpen the rim of a grown plate and strike one foe with it as with a short blade.

name: Flake Shot
description: Snap a flake from a grown plate and fling it at one foe like a small throwing blade.

name: Plate Stride
description: Grow a flat plate beneath the foot and push off it, to cross broken or slick footing in one stride.

name: Sliver Spray
description: Shed a spray of small metal slivers from a grown plate in a fan before the user, to cut the foes who stand close together in front.
